    [5, 4, 8, 9, 7, 10],
    [7, 5, 4, 8, 9, 7],
    [9, 8, 7, 4, 5, 6],
    [8, 9, 6, 5, 4, 7],
    [10, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4],
    [6, 7, 5, 8, 6, 7],
    [7, 6, 8, 5, 7, 4],

    [3, 4, 2, 2, 1, 3],
    [4, 3, 3, 2, 2, 1],
    [2, 3, 1, 3, 2, 3],
    [3, 2, 3, 1, 3, 1],
]

m.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for i in zones) <= capacity[j] * y[j] for j in sites), name="capacity")
m.addConstrs((gp.quicksum(x[i, j] for i in zones) >= 20 * y[j] for j in sites), name="min_movement")
